name: Wellness Lifestyle Four-Panel
name_es: Cuadrícula de bienestar de cuatro escenas

overall_theme.description: A curated series of four ultra-photorealistic vignettes showcasing a luxurious, wellness-focused lifestyle.
overall_theme.mood: Calm, serene, balanced, sophisticated, peaceful, rejuvenating.
overall_theme.style: Minimalist, high-end, contemporary, clean aesthetic, aspirational.

scenes.environment: White marble island and countertops, white shaker cabinets, gold hardware, integrated wine fridge, large window.
scenes.pose: Standing at the island, body angled slightly, looking down.
scenes.action: Whisking a hot beverage in a small bowl.

scenes.environment: Large backlit mirror, white marble vanity, white walls, orchid plant.
scenes.pose: Standing facing the mirror, one hand applying product to face.

scenes.environment: Textured beige walls with curved arches, stone water fountain, eucalyptus in a vase.
scenes.pose: Full-body stretch, arms extended overhead, head tilted back, eyes closed.

scenes.environment: Round white marble table, cane chair, large window overlooking a street.
scenes.pose: Sitting at the table, smiling while eating, holding a fork.

camera_and_technical.focus: Sharp focus on the subject in each frame.
camera_and_technical.depth_of_field: Shallow, creating a soft, creamy bokeh in the background.
